content:
alex: I opened a PR updating the starter app for SDK v5 + a simple CI deploy step. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2345

maria: nice. what changed for auth? Is that the env var rename we discussed?

alex: yes — swapped REDWOOD_API_KEY -> RW_API_TOKEN to match the SDK default. Left the old name in a commented example with a deprecation note.

sam: can we show both in the snippet (commented) so users can copy/paste without breaking existing setups?

alex: done. snippet in the PR: 

````
export RW_API_TOKEN=\"...\"
# legacy: REDWOOD_API_KEY (deprecated)
````

dave: CI deploy step LGTM but one small nit: dockerfile uses python:3.10-slim. We standardized on 3.11 for starters. can you bump?

alex: updated to python:3.11-slim in the last commit.

jen: linkcheck failed in the docs CI: /docs/getting-started/auth is 404, that's what's causing the build to fail.

alex: found it — route got moved to /docs/auth/intro in the nav reorg. I fixed the link and added a redirect note. Also added a changelog entry.

maria: great. can eng-qa give a thumbs on the staging deploy? tagging @qa-bot to schedule.

qa-bot: Deploy scheduled to staging at 2024-09-18 04:15 UTC :rocket: (will report back here).

alex: thanks — also added a tiny section in the quickstart about the CI deploy step (uses GitHub Actions with a single job that runs tests + pushes the image). Example in PR.

sam: quick nit on wording: "set RW_API_TOKEN" -> "export RW_API_TOKEN" in the shell snippet so it works in mac/linux.

alex: fixed wording and squashed commits.

dave: I can eyeball the staging once QA finishes. if green i'll approve later today.

jen: re: the redirect, can we add a short note for enterprises that rely on absolute links? maybe a header in the auth page pointing to the new path.

alex: added a small banner on /docs/auth/intro that mentions the old path and the deprecation timeline.

maria: thanks, everyone. i'll review the wording for the quickstart tomorrow morning. target ship EOD Fri if CI is green and no blockers. :thumbsup:
